plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} sets down {PAWN_possessive} tools and asks for a word. It turns out to be several.
{PAWN_nameDef} has clearly been working up to this all day.
Over the scrape of shovels and the hiss of the cookfire, {PAWN_nameDef} makes {PAWN_possessive} case.
{PAWN_nameDef} catches up with whoever's nearest the stockpile and doesn't let go of the subject.
It comes out sideways, the way important things do, in the middle of a conversation about something else entirely.
{PAWN_nameDef} has a request, and has rehearsed it, and still fumbles the opening.
Somewhere between one chore and the next, {PAWN_nameDef} stops and says it out loud.
{PAWN_nameDef} leans against the doorframe with the air of someone who isn't leaving until this is said.
[morning] {PAWN_nameDef} brings it up over breakfast, between two mouthfuls.
[morning] Before the day's work has properly started, {PAWN_nameDef} is already asking for something.
[morning,winter] Breath steaming in the morning cold, {PAWN_nameDef} clears {PAWN_possessive} throat.
[day] {PAWN_nameDef} wipes {PAWN_possessive} hands on {PAWN_possessive} trousers and walks over with purpose.
[evening] It comes out at supper, the way these things do once the work is done and the bowls are empty.
[evening] As the light goes amber, {PAWN_nameDef} finally says what's been sitting on {PAWN_possessive} chest all day.
[night] {PAWN_nameDef} can't sleep, and has decided this is the moment to discuss it.
[night] Long after the lamps are out, {PAWN_nameDef} is still awake, staring at the ceiling and composing a speech. This is the speech.
[rain] With the rain drumming on the roof and nowhere to be, {PAWN_nameDef} finally says it.
[rain,!summer] Cold rain sheets past the door. {PAWN_nameDef} watches it for a while, then turns around.
[snow] Stamping snow off {PAWN_possessive} boots, {PAWN_nameDef} decides today is the day to ask.
[snow] Snow piles up against the walls. Inside, {PAWN_nameDef} brings up something that has nothing to do with snow, and everything to do with being stuck indoors.
[storm] Thunder cracks overhead. {PAWN_nameDef} waits for it to roll past, then says what's been on {PAWN_possessive} mind.
[fog] Out of the fog comes {PAWN_nameDef}, with the look of someone who has been rehearsing.
[hot] Wiping sweat out of {PAWN_possessive} eyes, {PAWN_nameDef} stops work long enough to make a point.
[cold,!snow] Hands jammed under {PAWN_possessive} armpits for warmth, {PAWN_nameDef} raises a matter.
[spring] The thaw has everyone thinking about what comes next. {PAWN_nameDef} has thought about it more than most.
[fall] With the harvest coming in and the evenings drawing close, {PAWN_nameDef} speaks up.
[lowmood] {PAWN_nameDef} has been quiet for days. Today, something gives.
[lowmood] There are dark circles under {PAWN_nameDef}'s eyes, and a request on {PAWN_possessive} lips.
[highmood] In a rare good mood, {PAWN_nameDef} decides to push {PAWN_possessive} luck.
[highmood] {PAWN_nameDef} is practically humming. Then comes the ask.
[trait:Abrasive] {PAWN_nameDef} doesn't so much ask as announce.
[trait:Abrasive] {PAWN_nameDef} interrupts someone else's conversation to start this one.
[trait:Kind] {PAWN_nameDef} waits until nobody's busy, then asks, almost apologetically.
[trait:Greedy] {PAWN_nameDef} has been taking stock of what everyone else has. Now it's {PAWN_possessive} turn.
[trait:Jealous] {PAWN_nameDef} has been keeping count. It shows.
[trait:Psychopath] {PAWN_nameDef} states it the way one might state the weather.
[trait:Ascetic] For once, {PAWN_nameDef} wants something. People actually stop to listen.
[trait:Industriousness] {PAWN_nameDef} asks without stopping work, which is either efficient or rude.
[trait:Bloodlust] {PAWN_nameDef} is cleaning a blade while asking. It may not be deliberate.
[trait:Pyromaniac] {PAWN_nameDef} is fiddling with a tinderbox the entire time. Nobody comments.
[trait:Nerves] {PAWN_nameDef}'s voice cracks halfway through, but {PAWN_pronoun} gets there.
[old] With the creak of old knees, {PAWN_nameDef} lowers into a chair and says "Now listen."
[old] {PAWN_nameDef} has outlived worse than this colony, and is not shy about mentioning it.
[child] {PAWN_nameDef} tugs at the nearest sleeve until someone listens.
[child] {PAWN_nameDef} has drawn a picture of what {PAWN_pronoun} wants. It is surprisingly clear.
[teen] {PAWN_nameDef} rolls {PAWN_possessive} eyes before saying it, to make it clear this is not a big deal. It is a big deal.
[hurt] Still bandaged, {PAWN_nameDef} limps over to make a request.
[hurt] {PAWN_nameDef} winces when {PAWN_pronoun} sits down, and makes sure everyone notices.
[newcomer] Barely unpacked, {PAWN_nameDef} already has opinions about the place.
[afterraid] The smoke from the last attack has barely cleared when {PAWN_nameDef} speaks up.
[afterraid] There's still blood being scrubbed off the floor. {PAWN_nameDef} has had time to think.
[grieving] Grief makes people blunt. {PAWN_nameDef} doesn't bother with pleasantries.
[repeat] {PAWN_nameDef} raises the matter again. Not for the first time.
[repeat] It's the same request as before. {PAWN_nameDef} has simply decided to be heard this time.
[repeat,trait:Abrasive] Again. {PAWN_nameDef} is bringing it up again, louder.
[bitter] {PAWN_nameDef} asks without much hope, the way one asks the sky for rain.
[bitter] "I know how this goes," {PAWN_nameDef} says, before asking anyway.
[trusting] {PAWN_nameDef} asks with the easy confidence of someone who's been listened to before.
[doubtful] {PAWN_nameDef} asks, but the tone says {PAWN_pronoun} isn't expecting much.
[small] In a colony this small, there's no such thing as a private request. {PAWN_nameDef} makes one anyway.
[large] {PAWN_nameDef} has to wait in line behind two other complaints, but gets there.
[poor] Everyone knows the colony is scraping by. {PAWN_nameDef} asks anyway, and looks a little ashamed of it.
[rich] With the storerooms full, {PAWN_nameDef} sees no reason not to ask.
[tribal|medieval] At the fire that evening, {PAWN_nameDef} speaks before the elders can.
[forother] {PAWN_nameDef} glances over at {FOR_nameDef} before speaking, as if checking it's all right.
[forother] {FOR_nameDef} would never ask. {PAWN_nameDef} has decided to do it for {FOR_objective}.
[trigger:raid] The wounded are still being carried in when {PAWN_nameDef} grabs someone's arm.
[trigger:raid] {PAWN_nameDef} stands over the spent casings and broken bodies, shaking, and says what everyone is thinking.
[trigger:raid,lowtech] Arrows still stick out of the walls. {PAWN_nameDef} pulls one free and holds it up as {PAWN_possessive} argument.
[trigger:raid] Nobody has washed the blood off yet. {PAWN_nameDef} doesn't wait for that.
[trigger:death] They buried no one yet. {PAWN_nameDef} keeps looking at the body, then away, then back.
[trigger:death] The news has gone around the colony twice already. {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't said a word until now.
[trigger:death] {PAWN_nameDef} has been sitting in the same spot for an hour. When {PAWN_pronoun} finally speaks, it's quiet.
[trigger:cold] {PAWN_nameDef} spent the night shivering under a blanket that was not up to the job.
[trigger:cold] Frost on the inside of the walls. {PAWN_nameDef} wakes up angry about it.
[trigger:cold] Blue-lipped and stamping {PAWN_possessive} feet, {PAWN_nameDef} has had enough of the cold.
[trigger:heat] {PAWN_nameDef} lay awake half the night in a puddle of {PAWN_possessive} own sweat.
[trigger:heat] The air in the sleeping quarters is like soup. {PAWN_nameDef} emerges red-faced and short-tempered.
[trigger:floor] {PAWN_nameDef} finishes a meal eaten hunched on the floor, and stands with crumbs on {PAWN_possessive} knees and a complaint on {PAWN_possessive} lips.
[trigger:floor] Another dinner off the dirt. {PAWN_nameDef} sets the bowl down very deliberately.
[trigger:barracks] {PAWN_nameDef} slept badly again. Someone snored. Someone always snores.
[trigger:barracks] Woken for the third time by someone's elbow, {PAWN_nameDef} is ready to talk about living arrangements.
[trigger:rawfood] {PAWN_nameDef} is still chewing something raw and unidentifiable when {PAWN_pronoun} speaks.
[trigger:sick] Pale and sweating, {PAWN_nameDef} drags {PAWN_objective} upright long enough to make a point.
[trigger:sick] Between bouts of being violently ill, {PAWN_nameDef} has had time to think about the kitchen.
[trigger:dark] {PAWN_nameDef} stubbed a toe on something in the dark. The something was {PAWN_possessive} own bed.
[trigger:naked] Shivering and trying to keep some dignity, {PAWN_nameDef} makes a request.
[trigger:cabin] Days indoors have worn {PAWN_nameDef} down to a fine, brittle edge.
[trigger:corpse] The smell drifts in from outside. {PAWN_nameDef} wants something done about it, and also something else.
[trigger:envy] {PAWN_nameDef} has been looking at {ENVIED_nameDef}'s new arrangement all morning.
[trigger:envy] {PAWN_nameDef} watched {ENVIED_nameDef} get what {ENVIED_pronoun} asked for. Now {PAWN_nameDef} is doing the arithmetic.
[trigger:passion] {PAWN_nameDef} has the itch again: hands that want to be doing the thing {PAWN_pronoun} loves.
[trigger:injury] {PAWN_nameDef} is still learning to walk without the old leg. Or hand. Or eye. It shows.
[trigger:title] Fresh from receiving a title, {PAWN_nameDef} looks around the colony with new and critical eyes.
{PAWN_nameDef} stands in the doorway for a long moment before saying anything.
{PAWN_nameDef} walks around it twice, touches it once, and only then turns around.
{PAWN_nameDef} finds whoever made it happen and says so, more or less.
It takes {PAWN_nameDef} a while to notice. When {PAWN_pronoun} does, the whole colony hears about it.
[evening|night] That night, {PAWN_nameDef} lingers by the fire a little longer than usual, smiling at nothing.
[trait:Abrasive] {PAWN_nameDef} inspects it with narrowed eyes, looking for a flaw, and fails to find one.
[trait:Kind] {PAWN_nameDef} thanks everyone who touched it, by name, including the hauler who just carried the wood.
[trait:Psychopath] {PAWN_nameDef} nods once. From {PAWN_objective}, it's practically a parade.
[promised] A promise, kept. {PAWN_nameDef} remembers that sort of thing.
[petition] Everyone who asked for it crowds round at once, talking over each other.
[bitter] {PAWN_nameDef} had stopped expecting anything. It shows on {PAWN_possessive} face, which doesn't quite know what to do.
[child] {PAWN_nameDef} runs to tell everyone, then runs back to make sure it's still there.
[old] {PAWN_nameDef} nods slowly, the way old people do when something is right.
I saw what {ENVIED_nameDef} got.
Since we're handing things out now, and {ENVIED_nameDef} got one...
No offence to {ENVIED_nameDef}, but I've been here just as long.

warm.li: I'm glad for {ENVIED_nameDef}, truly. It just made me realize I'd love the same.
Seeing {ENVIED_nameDef} so happy got me thinking.

blunt.li: So {ENVIED_nameDef} gets one and I don't? Funny.
Right. {ENVIED_nameDef} asked, {ENVIED_nameDef} got. My turn.
What's {ENVIED_nameDef} got that I haven't? Apart from the obvious, now.

cheerful.li: Okay, I saw {ENVIED_nameDef}'s and I'm officially jealous. Happily jealous!

gloomy.li: Some people ask and get. I notice these things.

cold.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} set a precedent. I'm invoking it.
Fair is fair. {ENVIED_nameDef} received one; so should I.

plain.li: I'll hold you to that.
A promise, then. Good. I'll stop asking. For now.
Right. I'll believe it when I see it, but I'll believe it.

warm.li: Thank you. Really. Take the time you need.
That's all I wanted to hear.

blunt.li: Promised. Remember you said that.
Fine. Don't make me bring it up again.

cheerful.li: A promise! I'm writing that down. Somewhere. In my heart.

gloomy.li: Promises are cheap out here. Still. Thanks.

cold.li: Noted. I will check on progress.
An agreement, then. Agreements are kept or they aren't.

plain.li: No? Well. At least you said so.
I suppose there are bigger problems. There always are.
[trusting] I understand. I don't like it, but I understand.
[poor] I know we're stretched thin. Doesn't make it easier.
[afterraid] Right. Walls first. I get it.

warm.li: That's all right. I'd rather know than wonder.
Thank you for being honest with me.

blunt.li: Fine. Remember this next time you need something hauled.
Great. Wonderful. Thrilled.
[bitter] Didn't even pretend to think about it, did you?

cheerful.li: Oh. Well! Can't win them all. I'll ask again when you're in a better mood.

gloomy.li: I don't know why I asked.

cold.li: Understood. I will adjust my expectations accordingly.

plain.li: Not to nag, but... about {WISH}.
Just checking: has anyone thought about {WISH}?
Still hoping for {WISH}, in case anyone forgot.
[promised] You did promise. I'm not saying anything. I'm just saying.
[winter] It's a long winter to spend wishing. {WISH}, remember?
[night] Can't sleep. Thinking about {WISH}. Again.
[petition] We're all still waiting on {WISH}. All of us.

warm.li: No rush, truly. But if there's ever a spare moment, {WISH} would mean a lot.
I don't want to be a bother. I'm just still hoping, that's all.

blunt.li: {WISH}. Still nothing. Just so we're clear.
I asked. Days ago. Anyone?
Is this thing on? {WISH}. Hello?

cheerful.li: Day whatever of waiting for {WISH}. Morale: holding.

gloomy.li: I suppose {WISH} isn't happening. I'll stop mentioning it. After this.
Everyone's too busy for {WISH}. Everyone's always too busy.

plain.li: I won't ask about {WISH} again. Make of that what you will.
Last time I bring up {WISH}. After this, I'm done asking.
[promised] You promised me {WISH}. Time's nearly up on that promise.
[petition] There are a few of us waiting on {WISH} now. We're starting to talk.

warm.li: I've been patient about {WISH}. I'm trying to stay patient.
I don't want to make a fuss. But {WISH}... it matters to me.

blunt.li: {WISH}. Now, or forget I ever asked. I won't forget, though.
I'm done being polite about {WISH}.
You've got a few days. Then I stop caring what you think of me.

cheerful.li: So, funny story, I'm actually getting a bit upset about {WISH}! Ha. Ha.
My famous good mood has limits, and {WISH} is finding them.

gloomy.li: I'll just keep waiting, then. It's what I'm good at.
Nobody cares about {WISH}. That's fine. That's fine.

cold.li: Final request regarding {WISH}. I will draw my own conclusions afterwards.
You are running out of time to address {WISH}.

plain.li: If you want something done around here, apparently you do it yourself.
Nobody else was going to. So.
[trait:Industriousness] Waiting is worse than working. Done.

warm.li: I didn't want to bother anyone. I hope that's all right.
I figured everyone was busy, so I took care of it.

blunt.li: Did it myself. You're welcome.
Next time I ask for something, maybe just say yes. Saves time.

cheerful.li: Took matters into my own hands! They're very capable hands.

gloomy.li: Doesn't feel as good when you have to do it yourself.

cold.li: The request was not addressed. I addressed it.

plain.li: I asked for {MINE} first.
So {OTHER_nameDef} jumps the queue. Good to know.
Funny how some requests get answered.

warm.li: Good for {OTHER_nameDef}. Really. I'll just keep waiting.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asks, {OTHER_nameDef} gets. I ask, I get nothing.
I was here first. With {MINE}. Remember?

cheerful.li: Happy for {OTHER_nameDef}! Also, gently, me! Remember me?

plain.li: You promised. You actually promised.
I stopped asking because you gave me your word. That's on me, I suppose.
Remember this the next time you ask me to trust you.

warm.li: I believed you. I'm not angry. I'm just... I believed you.

blunt.li: Your word's worth less than a rotten potato. At least the potato's honest about it.
Never again. Never.

cheerful.li: Ha! Fooled me. Good one. Really. Great.

gloomy.li: I knew it. I knew it and I believed it anyway.

cold.li: A promise was made and not kept. I have updated my assessment of you.

plain.li: Ask the council? Might as well ask the rocks.
Don't bother asking for anything. I've tried.
They'll listen to you right up until you need something.
[winter] Long winter. Longer when nobody listens.
[afterraid] We bleed for this place, and for what?

blunt.li: I'm not asking for anything. Ever again. Write that down.
Council. Ha. Talking shop for people who never have to haul.

gloomy.li: I used to think it mattered what I wanted.
Nobody here cares. I've made my peace with it. Mostly.

cold.li: This colony's leadership has consistently failed to meet my requests. I've noted each instance.

cheerful.li: You know what's great? Expecting nothing. Can't be disappointed!

warm.li: I try not to take it personally. It's getting harder.
